description: Trigger-recall probes: realistic user requests labelled with the skill that should handle each. Used to A/B flat vs. routed skill menus (see check_recall.py). Keep expected names in sync with skills.json.

prompts.prompt: We keep re-litigating past architecture decisions. Set up a durable record of the important ones in this repo.
I'm starting a new service and can't decide between a modular monolith and microservices, or how to organize the code inside it.
Can you help me sketch a C4 diagram of our system — context and container views — and render it as Mermaid?
What vocabulary should I use to reason about whether a module is 'deep' or 'shallow' as I design it?
This codebase feels tangled. Measure the coupling and cohesion — instability, abstractness, LCOM — and tell me which modules are in the zone of pain.
Help me do domain-driven design: classify our subdomains, map bounded contexts, and get the aggregate and value-object conventions right in code.
I want automated CI checks that fail the build when someone violates our layering rules or introduces a dependency cycle.
Decompose this new feature into named logical components without falling into the entity-trap.
Review how our microservices talk to each other — boundaries, contract versioning, sagas, circuit breakers.
Design the SQL schema for this feature and help me think about partitioning and query patterns.
I spotted a long method with duplicated branches. Should I refactor it, and which Fowler technique applies?
Rewrite these functions so the file reads top-down, one level of abstraction per function.
Let's build this feature test-first — write the failing test before the implementation.
This migration is risky and I can't foresee all the impact. How do I stage the rollout safely?
Help me wire up an LLM application — prompt structure, tool calling, evals for the agent.
Walk me through the lifecycle of an ML project from framing to deployment and monitoring.
Turn our messy internal style notes into a distilled, enforceable set of coding guidelines.
I want to quickly throw together a throwaway prototype to validate this idea.
Help me author a new Claude skill for this repo, with the right frontmatter and structure.
Write up the three migration options side by side so the team can weigh them, with a timeline and a diagram of each.
